concept: Use case: product-mockup. Create a richer RAVENCLAW CELESTIAL ATELIER vehicle wrap concept presentation, using the supplied FIVE actual renders of the original pre-2025 Tesla Model Y as hard geometry references. Output a 2x2 design board with large left side, right side, front three-quarter and rear three-quarter views of the SAME cohesive design. Preserve original Tesla silhouette, wheels, door handles, mirrors, windows, headlights and all panel seams exactly. Paint only painted body areas; roof glass stays black. Deep midnight sapphire, aged bronze and parchment-blue engraving. Design specifically FOR this body: long eagle flight feathers flow across both doors along the shoulder crease, never a pasted square crest; each real black flush door handle sits inside a delicate bronze astrolabe/orbit surround; feather roots and filigree curl around mirror bases; fine bronze pinstripes follow the narrow painted roof rails beside the glass, not over glass; a broad celestial navigation/armillary illustration fits the hood outline with quiet margins; rear hatch gets a coherent compass and constellation treatment; subtle astronomical cartography lives below the door crease and sweeps around wheel arches. Rich but disciplined, hand-engraved artwork with large readable feather forms and intentional negative space, no tiny writing, no invented extra hardware. Avoid repeated badge stickers, frames around each door, fake handles, actual metallic protrusions, carbon fiber, neon, and scenic backgrounds. Flat matte printed ink appearance on body, restrained lighting. This is a paint-only design to be subsequently decomposed into the exact Tesla UV texture. Make it dramatically richer than a navy car with a small emblem.
atlasA: Decompose the supplied Ravenclaw Celestial Atelier multi-view concept into a production UV atlas. Preserve its expressive wings, astrolabe, map linework and relationship to vehicle features. Output ONE square flat 2D UV texture atlas, no cars, no lighting, no shadows, no labels or text. Match the EXACT island positions and silhouettes in the black-white template. Artwork must reach each island edge with safe bleed; outside islands solid midnight navy #10243c. The labeled guide is instructions only; REMOVE all blue labels and red markers. At 1024 coordinates the hood is x361..663 y151..393; bumpers top and bottom; mirrors centered (260,425) and (768,425); painted roof rails x330 and690 from y150..630; central black rectangle is unpaintable glass and must remain plain. SIDE ISLANDS ARE ROTATED: top of vehicle door is the INWARD edge (right edge of left-hand atlas islands, left edge of right-hand atlas islands). Nose of car is toward TOP of atlas and rear toward BOTTOM. Make feathers flow down the atlas side columns from front fender y100..280 through front door y290..530 and rear door y540..750. Near the upper-car door edges the true handle anchor positions are (173,492),(177,712),(851,492),(847,712); each handle is a narrow slit parallel to the atlas Y axis, surrounded by a subtle bronze orbital oval centered precisely here. These are not door-centre emblems. Keep 12px quiet margins around important motifs. Fine bronze rail lines follow narrow curved rail islands. Mirrors receive small coherent feather tips. Hood celestial astrolabe, rear hatch compass. No fake headlights or grille, no black handle drawings; real hardware remains visible from mesh. Rich full-body midnight sapphire, aged bronze and parchment-blue celestial engraved ink, broad readable feather forms rather than repeated crests. Accurate correspondence and complementary panels are paramount.
